en.title: OLIVE AT THE BIKE RACK
en.caption: An olive jacket with a burgundy hoodie.
en.intro: An everyday moment, unlocking a bike. Olive and burgundy, matched with black denim and boots, make an easy street outfit.
en.tip: Before you ride, check that the hood doesn't block your view and your trouser hems stay clear of the chain.

products.descriptor: Dark olive waterproof hooded field jacket, dark snap front, flap pockets, structured relaxed body, cuff tabs.

howToWear.ko: 스냅을 가슴 아래까지만 채워 버건디 후디가 V자로 보이게 하고, 백팩 끈은 재킷 위로 메세요.
howToWear.en: Snap it only up to below the chest so the burgundy hoodie shows in a V, and wear the backpack straps over the jacket.
